title: GeoServer JVM heap autoscaling (example)
description: Example dashboard: adapt datasource, workload filters and thresholds to your installation. Important panels show heap usage, HPA inputs and replicas; optional panels show memory bytes and scrape health. Heap validation assumes 15-second scrapes. Dashboard variables do not configure Adapter or HPA.

list.name: statefulset
list.label: StatefulSet
list.description: GeoServer StatefulSet for replica queries; requires kube-state-metrics.

options.content:
Use this example as a starting point. Match the datasource, workload filters and thresholds to Adapter/HPA. Dashboard edits do not configure autoscaling.

**Important:** heap usage, HPA inputs and replicas. **Nice to have / check:** heap bytes and scrape health.

panels.title: Heap used — raw and smoothed
panels.description: Shows raw heap used/max and the validated 2-minute average for each JVM; this includes garbage awaiting collection.

targets.expr:
(max by (pod) ((
      (100 * avg_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) / java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})
      and (java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"} > 0)
      and (min_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) >= 0)
      and (max_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) <= java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})
      and (count_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) >= 3)
      and (count_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) >= 3)
      and (changes(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) == 0)
      and ((time() - timestamp(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})) < 45)
      and ((time() - timestamp(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})) < 45)
      and on (cluster,namespace,pod,job,instance) ((up{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - timestamp(up{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})) < 45))
    ))) and on (pod) (count by (pod) ((
      (100 * avg_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) / java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})
      and (java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"} > 0)
      and (min_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) >= 0)
      and (max_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) <= java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})
      and (count_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) >= 3)
      and (count_over_time(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) >= 3)
      and (changes(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"}[120s]) == 0)
      and ((time() - timestamp(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})) < 45)
      and ((time() - timestamp(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})) < 45)
      and on (cluster,namespace,pod,job,instance) ((up{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - timestamp(up{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",job=~"${heap_job:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:raw}",cluster=~"${cluster_regex:raw}"})) < 45))
    )) == 1)

panels.title: Heap pressure used by HPA
panels.description: Shows validated heap pressure above the activation baseline, in percentage points, against the HPA target of high_target minus activation.

panels.title: Completed request rate per pod
panels.description: Shows completed RPS per healthy pod supplied to HPA by Adapter, including monitored probes.

panels.title: Total completed request rate
panels.description: Sums completed RPS across healthy pod scrapes to show total monitored traffic.

panels.title: Ready / desired replicas
panels.description: Compares pods ready to serve with the StatefulSet replica count requested by HPA or fixed replicaCount.

panels.title: Heap bytes in each JVM
panels.description: Shows used and maximum heap bytes from each JVM; maximum is the percentage denominator.

panels.title: Scrape health and valid heap count
panels.description: Shows scrape success (1) or failure (0) and valid heap coverage; coverage is not the Kubernetes Ready replica count.
